# Hermes Agent

Updated: 2026-06-12
Canonical: https://hermesagent.studio/
Support: support@aigeamy.com

## Summary
Hermes Agent is a Persistent AI agent workspace for teams evaluating persistent AI agents, agent memory, and workflow automation. It helps users get a persistent agent workflow with memory, tool use, pricing, support, setup evidence, and clear recovery paths.
